Content.Name: Wizard Content
Content.Label: Configure content
Content.Hint: Choose which compendiums the wizard uses, their priority, and which species and subclasses players can pick.
Content.SourcesHint: Compendiums with D&D content. Unchecked compendiums are ignored. When the same option is in more than one compendium, the one higher in this list wins. This world uses {rules} rules.
Content.SpeciesHint: Uncheck a species to hide it from players.
Content.SubclassesHint: Uncheck a subclass to hide it from players.
Content.NoPacks: No compendiums with classes, species, backgrounds or feats were found.
Content.NoSpecies: No species found for this world's rules.
Content.NoSubclasses: No subclasses found for this world's rules.
Content.LanguagesHint: Uncheck a language to hide it from the language choices in the wizard. Languages a species or background grants outright are still given. Modules that add languages show up as their own group, so you can switch a whole group off and re-enable the few you want.

Untagged.Name: Content without a rules version
Untagged.Hint: Some homebrew or older content isn't marked as 2014 or 2024. Choose whether the wizard offers it.

AllowPlayers.Name: Players can use the wizard
AllowPlayers.Hint: When off, only the GM sees the Character Wizard buttons.

Choices.Hint: {name} asks you to decide the following. Pick an option to see what it does.
Choices.Inspect: Pick an option to read what it does.
